# Equivalent methods {.unnumbered}

CEN vs. current ISO-standards = equivalence by the law (without statistical validation???)

Bland-Altman, ROPE test, absolute vs. relative scale

$\delta_l, \delta_u$: symmetrical? 

expert elicitation: Bruno De Vos thinks it will be hard to find agreement between experts what level of $\delta$ can serve for equivalence

idea of Bruno is to use ring tests between soil labs to set levels for $\delta$:
we estimate the reproducibility variance with a ring test (possibly as a function of the value of the soil descriptor) and define equivalent methods as those that fall within 2 or 3 times the reproducibility variance
$$
\sigma^2_{\text{reproducibility}} = \sigma^2_{\text{repeatability}} + \sigma^2_{\text{inter-laboratory}}
$$
